scope: Issue #277's source-locked, workspace-specific Core REST inventory. Twenty generates REST and GraphQL schemas per workspace; no GraphQL or metadata operation is inferred from the REST contract.

source_lock.rule: Each of the 168 source-locked api_surface endpoints has exactly one covered_by projection; the listed artifacts are the non-duplicated operation manifest.

binary_read.evidence: The source-locked REST inventory has only JSON resource endpoints. Attachment resource CRUD is not an inferred binary transfer operation.

binary_write.evidence: The source-locked REST inventory has no upload or other binary transfer endpoint; no REST write is recast as binary.

direct_read.evidence: One operation-backed get command per Twenty object with exact REST path and json_redacted output policy.

direct_write.evidence: The source-locked REST mutations are schema-backed typed reverse-ETL actions, not direct-write operation contracts. GraphQL mutations are separately schema-generated per workspace and are not inferred.

reverse_etl.safety: Every action uses plan, preview, approval, and execute; all 28 delete actions retain typed destructive confirmation.

batch_array_envelope_certification.source_trace: Each of the 28 batch rows locks the published source URL, exact POST route, records envelope schema pointer, and declared maxItems 60.
batch_array_envelope_certification.command_status: all 28 remain implemented and CLI-reachable; none is partial or disabled

action_eligibility.rule: Every action remains implemented and CLI-reachable. Safety, privilege, and destructive classification govern execution and cannot be an ineligibility reason.

typed_destination.status: not_declared; provider idempotency contract is not published

provider_contract_gap.reason: the source-locked action contract has no idempotency_key_header; declaring generic typed delivery would invent a retry guarantee

typed_destination.boundary: The adapter cannot transport tombstones or form a required batch records array from one source record. Captain option C defers only the 28 batch-action application certifications to 0.3.1. Those transport limits, and the absent provider idempotency contract, do not remove, disable, or reclassify any typed CLI command.
typed_destination.application_dispatch: No Twenty generic typed destination is registered. This keeps App construction valid while direct typed commands remain implemented and safety-gated.
typed_destination.multiplicity_dependency: write_eligibility.json records 55 record-shaped actions that need provider-neutral per-action source bindings. No connector workaround is present.

executable_cli.evidence: TestAllProviderOperationsHaveExecutableCommands runs the actual commandrunner preflight for every command; connectorgen surface-sync verifies endpoint ownership.

reconciliation.dependency: foundation rollup content is present on main; batch-array application certification is explicitly deferred to 0.3.1 by captain option C
reconciliation.verification_contract: connector-local red/green persisted per-action destination and all-action eligibility tests prove the 28 batch rows retain exact source traces and implemented command reachability. This connector remains non-certified: fresh credentialed built-binary pagination, CRUD cleanup, ETL, reverse-ETL acknowledgement/read-back, and documented-binary proof are not claimed by this deferral slice.
